display_name: Phase1 fixed direct physical mixture ground test
description: Evaluate fixed source-selected direct physical IQ mixture, blind channel, input gate and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on seven Phase1 ground views; truth last.

data.representation: IQ [2,256], blind physical posterior, directly learned six-component mixture, frozen input gate and F
data.tx_sets_ref: No test truth, clean pair, U_s truth or V during inference; fixed ground test truth after all seven views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Controller trained using legal L_s fit labels and high-confidence frozen F pseudo labels for U_s; no U_s truth, V or test used in training
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.regime: Source-trained frozen candidate, fixed Phase1 ground test inference then truth-last scoring
permissions.query_use: Per-record received IQ and frozen F predictions only; no clean pair, labels or adaptation at inference
permissions.claim_scope: Repeatedly observed single-seed Phase1 ground development test, not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed direct source-trained mixture full blend, six-component posterior, blind estimator, gate .8, frozen F; no DURA inference.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Frozen direct source mixture training commit 25fe47b9101033b4343ee7b7825c0f7ad79885bc and fixed source selection blend1 gate0.8, source label audit completed.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source parent-protected selection +45 pseudo matches but not DURA-protected; true source L_s +1 RX4/6, +2 RX8 overall, RX8 low urban -2; not blind.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed blend1, gate .8 from source primary parent criteria; all seven Phase1 views complete before truth.

metric_names: per-view frozen F raw and restored accuracy
per-view clean-relative percentage point and relative percent gap
dimensions: 168000 Phase1 ground test physical records x seven views
metrics_plan.targets_ref: All six simulated satellite views at most 3 percentage points and 3% relative below F clean; clean output degradation <=1 percentage point

notes: No test truth or model update during prediction; candidate never calls DURA.
Blend and gate fixed from source; F saw source IDs and this Phase1 ground test was repeatedly observed.
Replay 1047 fixed source predictions on real checkpoint and gate before ground test.
All seven x 168000 predictions fixed before independent CPU truth scoring; no U_s truth or V.
Source RX8 low-urban pseudo-label and L_s results worsened, so performance transfer is uncertain.

rows.method: directly learned six-component physical posterior mixture
rows.purpose: Evaluate fixed source-selected DURA-free restoration with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
rows.seed_notes: Frozen direct network seed 2026121954; fit IDs seed 2026121855; fixed Phase1 test views.
